Group departure

Singapore Zhongjing TCM College — Fuxian Lake Wellness Journey

A confirmed eight-day group departure for a Singapore TCM college, built as a teaching journey rather than a spa stay: three lectures delivered by the college's own physicians sit alongside daily baduanjin practice, meridian tuina, moxibustion and food therapy.

Request a Call

Day by day

  • Day 1 · Arrival in Kunming — the programme opens

    16:35–18:00Airport pick-up. Group arrives at Changshui on the 12:20–16:35 flight; 38-seat coach meets the group.
    18:00–20:00Welcome dinner at a restaurant on the shore of Dianchi Lake.
    20:00–Check-in, rest, free time. Tentative hotel: Hilton Kunming Dianchi.

  • Day 2 · Herbal memory, then moving to the lake

    07:00–08:00Breakfast.
    08:00–09:30Haidong dam on Dianchi Lake — Siberian black-headed gulls.
    09:30–11:30Yunnan Baicao Village, a working herbal plant collection.
    11:30–12:30Transfer to the Sheng'ai health base at Fuxian Lake.
    12:30–13:30Medicinal food therapy lunch, served at table.
    13:00–14:30Check in and rest at Liuhe Xiaoyuan.
    14:30–15:30Guided tour of the base — therapy rooms, treatment menu, the grounds.
    15:30–16:00Welcome ceremony. Each guest receives a fresh flower.
    16:00–18:00Hands-on mugwort hammer workshop — herbal ingredients explained, made by hand, taken home.
    18:00–20:00Fuxian Lake dinner: copper-pot fish, copper-pot potato rice, light medicinal sides. Ingredients and their rationale explained.
    20:00–21:00Starlight night market and bonfire gathering.
    21:00–Return to the hotel. Herbal foot bath with a dehumidifying formula, plus soaking guidance.

    The hotel issues a comfort kit — dental floss, sunscreen, wipes, nail clippers, disposable towel set, herbal tea sachets. Umbrellas and power adapters are provided in-room. Halal, vegetarian and restricted diets are arranged separately for every meal on request.

  • Day 3 · Building the TCM foundation

    07:30–08:00Morning practice — baduanjin consolidation, coach correcting each movement.
    08:00–09:00Buffet breakfast.
    09:00–11:00Sheng'ai fourteen-meridian tuina session.
    11:00–12:00Herbal tea blending workshop.
    12:00–14:30Lunch and rest. Medicinal food therapy matched to body type; a full 1.5 hours of rest is protected.
    14:30–17:00Fuhaiwan wetland park — scenery, deep-breathing, flower fields, free time with a staff escort.
    17:30–18:30Medicinal dinner — full therapy menu, spring liver-nourishing theme.
    19:30–21:30TCM lecture by the Singapore Zhongjing college. Dr Zhang Yan — "The Stillness of Fuxian Lake and the Flow of Emotion: Balancing the Seven Emotions in TCM".
    21:00–Rest. Herbal foot bath and a sleep-supporting tea.

  • Day 4 · Nature and culture

    07:30–08:00Morning practice — baduanjin.
    08:00–09:00Buffet breakfast.
    09:00–12:00Luchong scenic area. Gentle shoreline walk with commentary.
    12:00–14:00Lunch and rest. Yunnan wellness cuisine.
    14:00–18:00Chengjiang lotus-root starch, an intangible cultural heritage: workshop visit, hands-on simplified production, tasting plain and medicinal versions (with osmanthus and goji).
    18:00–19:30Medicinal dinner — full therapy menu, spleen-and-stomach theme.
    19:30–21:30TCM lecture. Dr Zheng Aizhu — "Clouds Unfolding, Clouds Settling: The Wisdom of Body–Mind Harmony in the Yellow Emperor's Inner Canon".
    21:30–Rest.

  • Day 5 · Science, then therapy

    07:30–08:00Morning practice — baduanjin.
    08:00–09:00Buffet breakfast. Fresh lotus-root starch added to the line-up.
    09:00–12:00Chengjiang Fossil Site museum — a guided walk through palaeontology and what it says about ecology.
    12:00–14:00Lunch and rest. Yunnan crossing-the-bridge noodles, light and tonic broths available.
    14:30–17:30Moxibustion targeted at neck, shoulder, spleen and stomach, plus a gentle Sheng'ai therapy session. Therapists take questions.
    17:30–19:00Wild mushroom hotpot — medicinal broth, lung-nourishing theme.
    19:00–20:30TCM music therapy — guzheng and erhu recordings with acupressure instruction, guided by the college physician travelling with the group.
    20:30–21:30Private herbal soak in each room, blended to the guest's constitution identification, with guidance on use.
    21:30–Rest.

  • Day 6 · Therapy and tea

    07:30–08:00Morning practice — baduanjin plus meridian stretching.
    08:00–09:00Buffet breakfast.
    09:00–11:30Bronze ware museum in Jiangchuan, Yuxi — the first specialist bronze museum in central Yunnan, opened 1994, holding major Dian-kingdom bronzes including the ox-and-tiger table.
    11:30–14:30Lunch and rest. Yunnan regional dishes.
    14:30–15:30Health talk by the base physician on common misconceptions about daily health care in later life, with open Q&A.
    15:30–18:00Sheng'ai ethnic-medicine hot compress session.
    18:00–19:00Medicinal dinner — full therapy menu, qi-and-blood theme.
    19:00–21:00Herbal handicraft — women make herbal earrings, necklaces or bead bracelets; men make bead bracelets.
    21:00–Rest. Herbal foot bath, free conversation.

  • Day 7 · Town, market, and an all-lotus banquet

    07:30–08:00Morning practice — baduanjin, outdoors where the site allows.
    08:00–09:00Buffet breakfast.
    09:00–11:00Shihua Garden wet market in Chengjiang — lake fish, wild mushrooms, coloured glutinous rice balls, freshly fried potato cakes.
    11:00–12:00Pu'er tea tasting — raw and ripe, health effects explained, served with medicinal tea snacks.
    12:00–14:00Lunch and rest. Dumpling banquet with wellness fillings — chive and egg, shiitake and wood ear, shrimp and lotus root.
    14:00–16:00Chengjiang Municipal Hospital of TCM — herbal wax compress. Warm, non-invasive, used for cold-pain in the joints and soft-tissue recovery.
    16:30–18:00Xiaowan village and Yunnan coffee tasting. A former farming and fishing village on the west shore, now a national rural-tourism demonstration village.
    18:00–19:00All-lotus banquet — more than ten preparations of lotus root, explained by a nutritionist.
    19:00–21:00Lecture. Dr Zhang Yan — "The Fuxian Lake Breeze that Clears the Mind: Practical Tools for Everyday Emotional Adjustment".
    21:00–21:30Herbal sachet workshop — a licensed pharmacist guides the selection of calming, sleep-supporting herbs.
    21:00–Foot bath and rest.

  • Day 8 · Departure — the programme continues at home

    07:30–08:00Morning practice — baduanjin plus meridian stretching.
    08:00–09:00Buffet breakfast, light and easy to digest for travel.
    09:00–11:00Wellness salon and sharing session. Guests compare notes; the physician summarises individual recommendations.
    12:00–14:30Lunch (nine-body-type medicinal menu), rest, check out.
    14:30–17:00Dounan flower market, the largest fresh-cut flower trading market in Asia.
    17:00–18:00Transfer to the airport. The group is seen to the gate and given departure wellness notes on travel diet and rest.
    21:25Flight departs.
Duration
8 days / 7 nights

Included gift

The college presents each guest with a Yunnan gift box valued at close to RMB 500: Jianshui purple clay ware, plateau crimson rose, Fuxian Lake lotus-root starch, polygonatum-and-jade-bamboo lotus starch, and a wellness pack.
